why: The desk's own notebook: what a person looked up when no provider could. Each note names the team, the question it answers (starting_qb, starting_qb_confirmation, ol_availability, ol_replacement, defensive_personnel, weather, current_price), the text, the source name and url, when the source published it, who recorded it and when, and an expiry. The investigation loop reads it as a provider and reports each note as FOUND with its source and publication time, never as a search. A note without a url, a publication time or a recorder is refused by tools/football/add_note.js.
